Lives outside engine/live.py so research code never imports the live order path (Bible Phase 28 / quality gate import boundary).

## engine.fill_audit

Bible Phase 1.4 / canon C33, as a Test-loop gate: prove from a finished Session that every decision was taken at a close and filled at the NEXT session's open - never at the same close, never on a weekend - by feeding the Session's own records into engine.pit.audit_fills. Works on a live Session or on a replay.

- `def session_calendar(closes)` - The window's own sessions are the calendar: a fill on a date that is not a session of the window is an error.
- `def frames_from_session(S)` - (decisions, fills) frames in the shape pit.audit_fills expects, or (None, None) if the Session keeps no fills.
- `def audit_session(S, opens, closes)` - Run the fill audit. Returns {"status": PASS|FAIL|UNAUDITABLE, "errors": [...], "n_fills": int, "summary": str}. opens may be None for archives built before open
- `def gate(S, opens, closes)` - (ok, one-line message) for the Test loop's gate printout. UNAUDITABLE is not ok.

Tests: `tests/test_fill_audit.py`

## engine.fv_pipeline

Bible Phase 38 checklist V1-V5 (Find volatility), canons C23 / C24 / C33: ONE point-in-time weekly pipeline.

- `class FVConfig [cost(self), hash(self)]`
- `def validate_bars(bars)` - Problems that would silently corrupt every downstream number (empty list = clean).
- `def week_end_sessions(sessions)` - Positions of the last session of each ISO week (a decision is taken at that close). The final session of the data is never a week end here: its week is not comp
- `def price_features(bars, min_price, min_dollar_vol)` - Daily price/volume features from OHLCV only (float32 wide frames, date x ticker) plus the `tradable` mask. Every value at row t uses bars up to and including t'

- `def synthetic_bars(n_tickers, n_weeks, seed, event_p, dir_acc, informative_mover, start)` - Planted market for tests. An event week gives a stock a +-13..22% drift; the decision day's own return is a large shock that announces the event (marker) and po
- `def reflect_short(p, side)` - Orient paths for the side of the bet. A short is the path reflected about its entry open (x -> 2e - x), so a long simulator run on it returns exactly the negate
- `def concat_paths(chunks)`
- `class MoverStage [fit(self, XR, y, dates), ok(self), score(self, XR)]` - P(the stock touches +-move next week). Trained on rows that had finished by the origin; the newest `cal_frac` of dates (one date purged) calibrate the probabili
- `def certify_threshold(p, y, target, min_rows)` - Smallest probability threshold whose precision on (p, y) reaches `target` with at least `min_rows` rows at or above it; None when no threshold does. Chosen on t
- `class DirectionStage [fit(self, XR, up, mover, dates, origin, extra), model_score(self, R), inputs(self, R, extra), decide(self, R, extra)]` - A mover-only direction model (fitted on the EARLY mover dates) feeds DirectionEngine, which stacks, calibrates and gates on the later dates - so the engine neve
- `class ComboRule [fit(self, train), dist(self, p), run(self, p)]` - An exit spec (target / trail / time) optionally combined with a learned stop distance from engine.stops. With `stop=None` this is a pure exit rule; with the nul
- `def exit_specs()` - Exit families of Phase 15 reduced to the ones that matter for a +10% goal (all share one fill simulator).
- `def stop_rules(cost)`
- `def build_rule_set(exits_on, stops_on, cost)` - [baseline] + exit rules (exits_on) + stop rules with the week-end exit (stops_on) + the cross of the two.
- `def fv_compare(a, b)` - Lexicographic FV objective: (1) feasibility of the catastrophic-loss budget, (2) share of positions reaching +10% (tolerance 1 pt), (3) mean net return (0.2 pt)

- `def learn_policy(train, rules, as_of, seed, cfg)` - Learn a per-type policy using ONLY positions that finished by `as_of`.
- `class LossCapFilter [fit(self, train), p_breach(self, p), keep(self, p)]` - gaprisk-based cash filter: a name whose model probability of a gap beyond (cap - stop distance) inside the week exceeds `tau` is not traded. Fitted on finished 
- `class FVRun`
- `def walk_forward(panel, cfg, calendar, pattern_factory, ckpt, log, last_block)` - Run the pipeline through time. `pattern_factory()` (optional) returns an object with fit(X, y, now) and features(Xday, as_of) -> DataFrame (engine.pattern_mover

- `def weekly_frame(run, pos)` - One row per traded decision week (weeks with no bet are rows of zeros - they are part of the record).
- `def mover_weekly(run)` - The mover stage on its own: hit rate of the top-n picks each week (V1).
- `def boot_index(n, B, block, rng)` - Circular moving-block bootstrap indices (B, n) over weeks; block=1 is the ordinary bootstrap.
- `def ci(stat, level)`
- `def summarize(run, stages, pos, boot, block, seed)` - The owner's metrics for one stage combination with bootstrap CIs over weeks (ratio metrics are ratios of sums).
- `def era_table(run, stages, years_per_era)` - Per-era breakdown (calendar years by default) of the same metrics, no CIs (eras are short).
- `def type_table(run, stages)` - Per stock-type breakdown of the bets actually taken.
- `def mover_report(run, boot, block, seed)` - V1: hit rate of the mover picks (touch and close) vs the all-candidate base rate, with a CI, tau95 coverage, and the calibration of the predicted probability.

## engine.gaprisk

Bible Phase 16 (Stop / loss engine), gap-risk part: the honest answer to "losers never worse than -20%".

- `class EventCalendar [realized(self, p), expected_in_week(self, p, tol_days, min_events)]` - Filing calendar keyed by ticker. A filing accepted before 09:30 ET moves that day's open; any later filing moves the NEXT session's open. Only kinds in `kinds` 
- `def fit_gpd(exc, xi_prior, n0)` - Generalised Pareto (xi, beta) for threshold excesses by probability-weighted moments (Hosking-Wallis), with the shape shrunk toward `xi_prior` by n/(n+n0) so a 
- `def gpd_sf(z, u, xi, beta, lam)` - P(Z > z) for z above the threshold u; lam is P(Z > u). Below u the answer is lam (a floor).
- `def gpd_quantile(t, u, xi, beta, lam)` - z such that P(Z > z) = t (t < lam).
- `class ConditionalGapModel [fit(self, train), p_night(self, p, level), p_position(self, p, level), night_quantile(self, p, prob), tail(self, p)]` - Adverse overnight gap tail conditional on (expected event in week, high-volatility regime), in ATR units.
- `def conditional_gap_factory(calendar, **kw)` - `fit_fn` for stops.StopRule.gap_model_fn: fits the conditional model on training positions.
- `def walk_forward_coverage(paths, factories, probs, min_train_weeks, block_weeks, label_fn)` - Per calendar year and model: how often does a night's adverse gap exceed the model's `prob` quantile, fitted only on earlier finished weeks? `label_fn(test)` sw
- `def coverage_summary(cov)` - Per model and probability: night-weighted exceed rate, worst era ratio and share of eras within 1.5x of target.
- `class LossCap`
- `def loss_cap_analysis(paths, calendar, cap, stop_k, min_train_weeks, block_weeks, **model_kw)` - Walk-forward: for each test block fit the conditional model on earlier weeks, give every position the model probability that a gap breaches the cap from where i
- `def policy_table(lc, taus, target)` - Realised P(position <= -cap) among the positions each avoidance rule would keep, per era and pooled. `meets_target` is judged on the Wilson UPPER bound, not the
- `def required_avoidance(lc, target)` - Most permissive model-probability cut whose pooled realised breach rate has upper bound <= target. `feasible` False means no cut on the model's ranking reaches 
- `def weight_cap_for_portfolio_hit(max_hit, cap)` - Sizing cannot lower P(position breach); it bounds the cost: weight * cap <= max_hit of the portfolio.
- `def calibration_of_p(lc, bins)` - Predicted vs realised breach probability by predicted-risk bin (does the ranking carry information?).

- `def classify(log_rows, result, expected_config, expected_window, expected_seed, current_code_hash, heartbeat_s, now, stale_check)` - One status per worker log. Precedence, most damning first: OOM, TIMEOUT, CRASHED, HUNG, INCOMPLETE, INVALID, STALE_CODE, OK. OK requires: start+config+window+se
- `def peak_memory(log_rows)`
- `def result_fingerprint(result)`
- `def exclusion_report(workers, current_code_hash, heartbeat_s, now, stale_check)` - workers: {id: {"log": rows, "result": dict|None, "config", "window", "seed"}}. Returns {"included": [...], "excluded": [{"worker","status","why"}], "counts": {.
- `def aggregate_ready(report, min_ok_fraction, require_all)` - May the batch be aggregated? Never fills a gap: excluded workers stay missing. `require_all` demands zero exclusions; otherwise at least `min_ok_fraction` of wo
- `def write_report(report, path)`
- `def memory_series(log_rows)` - [(t, rss_mb)] from memory events, in time order, ignoring unreadable samples.
- `def memory_growth_mb_per_min(log_rows)` - Least-squares slope of RSS over time. A worker that grows steadily will hit the ceiling eventually; the slope lets the supervisor warn before the OOM. None with
- `def projected_oom_minutes(log_rows, mem_limit_mb)` - Minutes until the ceiling at the current growth, or None when memory is flat/shrinking or unknown.
- `def heartbeat_gaps(log_rows)` - Seconds between consecutive heartbeats: (max gap, median gap, n). Used to size the heartbeat timeout from what workers actually do rather than a guess.
- `def suggested_heartbeat_s(all_logs, safety, floor)` - Timeout = safety x the largest gap seen among workers that COMPLETED, never below `floor`. Workers that died are excluded from the sample because their gap is w
- `def scan_dir(dir_path, pattern)` - {worker_id: log rows} for every log in a directory (the supervisor's own log lines are folded into the worker whose name the file carries).
- `def plan_rerun(report, seeds_in_use, next_seed)` - Reruns for excluded workers: NEW worker ids and NEW seeds, so the replacement can never be mistaken for, or merged into, the excluded one. Returns [{"replaces",
- `def failure_rates(reports_by_batch)` - {status: share} across batches; the crash rate an operator watches for creeping up.
- `def window_breakdown(workers, report)` - {window: {"assigned", "ok"}}: a window where every worker was excluded has no result at all and must show as a hole, not as an average of nothing.
- `def check_no_silent_replacement(report, results_used)` - `results_used`: worker ids whose results were fed to the aggregate. Fails when an excluded worker's result was used, or when a used id is unknown to the report.

- `def newey_west_t(x, lag)` - t-stat of the mean with Newey-West (Bartlett) standard error: IC series of overlapping windows are serially correlated, and the naive t overstates the evidence.
- `def series_stats(x, lag)`
- `def decay_fit(age_weeks, ic)` - Linear decay of the IC with model age: intercept, slope per week, half-life in weeks (nan unless it decays).

- `def cost_sensitivity(frame, grid_bps)` - Top-k excess return net of cost at several per-side costs, from the measured turnover.
- `def false_discovery_summary(origins, patterns)` - What survives: how many patterns were live, how many failed their own next block, how many are still live at the next refit, and how strong the search's own noi
- `def stability(frame, window)` - How steady the edge is through time, not just how big: information ratio of the daily rank IC, its lag-1 autocorrelation, the share of rolling windows with a po

- `def invented_ratio(origins_real, null_live_mean)` - Live patterns per origin the search reports on shuffled outcomes, relative to the real run. Near 1 means the miner reports as many 'patterns' from noise as from
- `def era_confidence(frame, cfg, n, seed)` - Block-bootstrap 90% interval of the rank IC inside each era (era means alone hide how noisy a short era is).
- `def compare_reports(previous, current, tol)` - Regression check between two runs (previous = a report JSON dict, current = a summary): list what got worse. A gate that flipped to fail, or an era/IC that fell
- `def run_heavy(X, y, cfg, seeds, null_seeds, n_hidden, hidden_len, eras, gates, out_dir, log, cache_dir)` - The full Phase 7 run. Returns a summary dict with every table and the verdict; optionally writes the machine- and human-readable report and logs the experiment.

- `def provenance_block(cfg, seeds, X, y)`
- `def render_markdown(s)`
- `def write_report(summary, out_dir)` - Machine-readable JSON + human-readable Markdown (Phase 36). Returns the two paths.
- `def ablation_across_eras(X, y, eras, cfg, seed, min_train_dates)` - Run the six-arm mover ablation with each era as the test window (trained on everything before it). A pattern family that only beats its controls in one era is a

Bible Phase 16 (Stop / loss engine), under the tiered objective of Phase 20.

- `def fit_gap_model(train, q, shrink)`

- `def filter_candidates(p, model, max_tail)` - Keep-mask: drop names whose learned gap tail alone is too large for any stop to matter.
- `def filter_effect(res, keep)` - What candidate filtering did to catastrophic exposure on a given result set.

- `def gap_calibration(model, test, bins)` - Is the learned gap tail honest out of sample? Within bins of predicted tail, the share of nights whose adverse gap exceeds the prediction should be about 1 - q.
- `class StopRule [dist(self, p), fit(self, train), run(self, p)]` - Base: subclasses define `dist(p)` (N,) and optionally `fail_exit`; the position exits on the stop or at week end.
- `class AtrStop [dist(self, p)]`
- `class FixedStop [dist(self, p)]` - Stock-type specific: a fixed distance; the per-type selector picks which one each type gets.
- `class VolPercentileStop [dist(self, p)]` - Stop at the q-quantile of the maximum adverse excursion seen in training among positions of similar volatility.
- `class GapAwareStop [dist(self, p)]` - ATR stop shrunk so that (stop distance + the name's learned gap tail) stays within `loss_target`.
- `class SizeAwareStop [dist(self, p)]` - ATR stop capped so weight * distance <= risk_budget of the portfolio.
- `class InvalidationStop [dist(self, p)]` - Pattern invalidation exit plus a wide catastrophe stop (invalidation is not gap-proof either).
- `class HybridStop [dist(self, p)]` - Tightest of ATR, gap-aware and size-aware distances, optional invalidation exit, optional gap-tail filter.

- `def log_stop_walk_forward(wf, cfg, seed)`

- `def type_gap_table(p, thr)` - Gap frequency and severity per stock type: which types a stop cannot protect.
- `def stop_era_breakdown(wf, years_per_era)` - Learned stops vs no stop by calendar era: P(loss>20%), expected loss and worst loss out of sample.
